headline: Alphabet's Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7 billion in the third quarter
body: Alphabet reported consolidated revenue of $127.6 billion, up 25%, and net income available to common stockholders of $26.2 billion. Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7 billion.
note: The release says the Cloud growth was led by enterprise AI infrastructure and enterprise AI solutions.

evidence.text: Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 25% to $127.6 billion, reflecting strong performance across the business and our 13th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.

Google Cloud delivered record growth as revenues increased 103% to $30.7 billion, led by strong growth in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI infrastructure and enterprise AI solutions, as well as core GCP services.
Net income available to common stockholders was $26.2 billion and EPS was $2.12.
